selected.text: 一同で地紙の厚さの写真と刃の角度の図を見比べた。机の端から端へ両方を回した。この写しは卯月の扉絵の記録と一緒に保管した。
会議録には切れ端入れの写真と、字が読み取れる大きさの台紙の余白の説明札を添えることになった。卯月の扉絵の古い索引で参照先をたどると台紙の余白の図がある。
話が切れ端入れに戻った。机に置いた折り丁の控えを参考に、向きを表す印を書き足した。卯月の扉絵の袋にも切れ端入れの図を挟んだ。
切れ端入れの図を二枚回覧した。台紙の余白の写しは出入口近くに貼り、帰り際にも見られるようにした。卯月の扉絵の綴りにも切れ端入れの紙がある。
切れ端入れの図を二枚回覧した。刃の角度の写しは出入口近くに貼り、帰り際にも見られるようにした。卯月の扉絵の綴りにも切れ端入れの紙がある。
刃の角度の拡大がほしいという発言があった。書記は折り丁の依頼の脇にその旨を書いた。卯月の扉絵の袋にも刃の角度の図を挟んだ。
卯月の扉絵の注文主と切り絵師が注文書を取り交わした。注文書の図案名は水紋。
台紙の余白の拡大がほしいという発言があった。書記は折り丁の依頼の脇にその旨を書いた。卯月の扉絵の袋にも台紙の余白の図を挟んだ。
書記は地紙の厚さの項の後を一行空けた。台紙の余白に関する発言は見開きの向かいに記す。卯月の扉絵の古い索引で参照先をたどると台紙の余白の図がある。

地紙の厚さの拡大がほしいという発言があった。書記は小窓の依頼の脇にその旨を書いた。この写しは卯月の扉絵の記録と一緒に保管した。

Twin Moons die • proof impressions exchanged with the press
Your question about the ink pad came in yesterday. I have attached the note on blotter sheet for comparison. The Twin Moons file also has a sheet for the ink pad.
I read the notes on blocking board aloud. One reader asked for a larger detail of the ink pad. The Twin Moons file also has a sheet for the blocking board.
I read the notes on transfer slip aloud. One reader asked for a larger detail of the ink pad. Among the Twin Moons papers, the pencilled index points to the ink pad.
Keep your copy of the blocking board sketch flat. I found the carbon for the blotter sheet in a stiff paper sleeve. The blocking board sketch appears in the Twin Moons folder too.
I read the notes on blotter sheet aloud. One reader asked for a larger detail of the ink pad. The blotter sheet sketch appears in the Twin Moons folder too.
The first production docket gave Maroon Lake as the ink for impressions from the Twin Moons die. The press kept a copy for its purchasing file.
I read the notes on ink pad aloud. One reader asked for a larger detail of the transfer slip. This copy was kept with the papers for Twin Moons.
After the proof dispute the press annulled the production docket for the Twin Moons impression ink. The purchasing copy has no force, and no replacement docket has been issued.
Keep your copy of the ink pad sketch flat. I found the carbon for the blotter sheet in a stiff paper sleeve. Among the Twin Moons papers, the pencilled index points to the blotter sheet.
I read the notes on blotter sheet aloud. One reader asked for a larger detail of the ink pad. Among the Twin Moons papers, the pencilled index points to the ink pad.
Maroon Lake is also the color of the printed border on the press's proof envelopes. Envelope stock comes from a different order.
作業控え　表には櫛歯の端の見取り図。裏は紙箱の切り欠きの写真を貼るため空けておく。この写しは風車箱の記録と一緒に保管した。
風車箱の昼実演では「風のたより」を回すと前の番組票に載せた。星箱にも同じ曲の交換シリンダーがある。
前の番組票を廃止した際、風車箱の昼実演の演目指定もいったん解いた。新しい演奏票はまだ演奏者に渡していない。
手元用の札　試奏の録音の脇には小さい見出しを設けた。ぜんまいの巻き数を参照するときは横の紙挟みを開くこと。風車箱の綴りにも試奏の録音の紙がある。
取扱欄　試奏の録音の写真は端を切りそろえた。回転のむらについては広く写った方を使う。風車箱の古い索引で参照先をたどると回転のむらの図がある。

Twin Moons die • proof impressions exchanged with the press
Your question about the ink pad came in yesterday. I have attached the note on blotter sheet for comparison. The Twin Moons file also has a sheet for the ink pad.
I read the notes on blocking board aloud. One reader asked for a larger detail of the ink pad. The Twin Moons file also has a sheet for the blocking board.
I read the notes on transfer slip aloud. One reader asked for a larger detail of the ink pad. Among the Twin Moons papers, the pencilled index points to the ink pad.
Keep your copy of the blocking board sketch flat. I found the carbon for the blotter sheet in a stiff paper sleeve. The blocking board sketch appears in the Twin Moons folder too.
I read the notes on blotter sheet aloud. One reader asked for a larger detail of the ink pad. The blotter sheet sketch appears in the Twin Moons folder too.
The first production docket gave Maroon Lake as the ink for impressions from the Twin Moons die. The press kept a copy for its purchasing file.
I read the notes on ink pad aloud. One reader asked for a larger detail of the transfer slip. This copy was kept with the papers for Twin Moons.
After the proof dispute the press annulled the production docket for the Twin Moons impression ink. The purchasing copy has no force, and no replacement docket has been issued.

Maroon Lake is also the color of the printed border on the press's proof envelopes. Envelope stock comes from a different order.
